'''Coramen''' is a town in [[Altara]], located on the east bank of the [[River Eldar]] on the [[Great North Road]], between [[Ebou Dar]] and [[Lugard]].

Coramen has a companion town called [[Alkindar]], which is on the west bank of the Eldar. There is a ferry that connects the two towns. When [[Valan Luca]]'s [[Valan Luca's Traveling Show|Traveling Show]] is traveling through Altara, they cross the ferry from Alkindar into Coramen. Despite the heavy presence of [[Seanchan]] troops, [[Tuon Athaem Kore Paendrag]] keeps her word to [[Matrim Cauthon]] not to betray them.{{ref/book|10|28}} While camped near Coramen, [[Renna Emain]] stabs [[Egeanin Tamarath]] and then steals a horse. She almost makes it back to Coramen when [[Harnan]] kills her with a crossbow bolt.{{ref/book|10|29}}
